text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: prod svc-config-api canary 5xx spike after config rollout. Pager triggered. incoming rate of errors ~12% on canary shard. thread_ts=1781234567

aj: I'm on it - seeing 5xx from /v1/embed and /v1/generate. Logs show KMS decrypt failures for the new key alias. pulling logs...

aj: ```
ERROR [decrypt] kms Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/svc-config-runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12
stack: com.redwood.crypto.KmsClient.decrypt(KmsClient.java:84)
```

maria: I flipped ENV_CONFIG=v2 and kicked the canary 10m ago. Did we rotate the key or the service account in that change?

kevin: Canary pods for v2 have REDWOOD_KEY_ALIAS=prod/key/v2. Old pods still use prod/key/v1. I can reproduce the AccessDenied for the service account used by the new replica set. Looks like the new KMS key's policy doesn't allow the IAM role.

aj: mitigation plan: 1) disable rollout feature flag to stop traffic to v2, 2) scale down v2 pods from the load balancer, 3) if necessary rollback helm release. Which is fastest?

maria: disabling flag now. I'll use the admin API.

maria: ```
# disable feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/flags/config_rollout_v2 -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

sylvia: flag off confirmed, new requests routed back to v1. I'm scaling down v2 replicas.

sylvia: ```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy svc-config-api-v2 --replicas=0
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=svc-config-api,version=v2 -o wide
```

sam: Metrics: 5xx rate on svc-config-api dropped from 12% -> 0.6% over last 3m. Latency normalizing. :white_check_mark:

aj: Good. Can we get a quick patch: either add kms:Decrypt permission for svc-config-runner to the new key policy OR revert key alias on the canary? Which is lower risk?

kevin: Lower risk is to fix key policy. The key was created by the rotation job and the rotation IAM principal wasn't added to the key policy. I'll open a short PR to update key policy and then we can re-run canary after verification.

maria: Filing follow-up ticket and postmortem notes. Impact: small percentage of requests - customers using embeddings endpoint may have seen errors for ~10 minutes on canary shard. No rollback required for global traffic.

aj: Owner for follow-up: aj. Action items: (a) update KMS key policy to include svc-config-runner and rotation-principal, (b) add pre-rollout IAM policy check to the deploy pipeline, (c) add a blocking check for key alias/permissions in canary job.

kevin: I'll take the next shift oncall for follow-ups. Handing off to @kevin.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate the key policy change and schedule a controlled re-canary once permissions are confirmed.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: traffic restored to baseline, automated pager closed. Severity: S2. References: runbook "deploy-config-rollout" updated.

aj: Thanks everyone. Leaving notes in the ticket and will draft the postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
